about: Billboard props, wall pieces and floor pieces for the set dressing (docs/art/set_dressing.md). One Gemini call per sheet: a sheet of four (2 x 2) or a single image. `tools/art/build_props.py --generate` makes the sources, then cuts them into art/sprites/props/. Sizes are world units (one unit = 5 ft): `height` for standing props and wall pieces, `width` for floor pieces.

views.stand: in the same three-quarter view from slightly above
views.wall: seen straight on from the front as a flat elevation with no perspective, as if fixed flat against a wall
views.floor: seen from directly above as a flat top-down view with no perspective, lying flat on the ground

sheet_prompt: A game prop sheet: four separate objects arranged in a 2 by 2 grid, each centred in its own quarter of the image with wide empty white space around it; the objects never touch, overlap or cross the middle of the image. Top left: {0}. Top right: {1}. Bottom left: {2}. Bottom right: {3}. Every object is shown whole, {view}, sized to fill most of its quarter, on a plain flat white background, no ground, no ground shadows, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no borders.
single_prompt: A single game prop: {0}, shown whole and alone, {view}, centred with space around it, on a plain flat white background, no ground, no ground shadow, nothing else in the image, no text.
